rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for one of two siblings born together, including animal twins.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 maa1 saang1 hing1 dai6

rows.note: Use this as a more explicit alternative, especially when referring to human twins; 孖生 is usually more natural in casual speech.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 deoi3 soeng1 baau1 toi1
